scenarios.title: Vault: a full vault never trims or sells; a worthwhile drop is not recorded
scenarios.pending_reason: not run: the runner cannot seed vault records yet. Missing: a `pre.vault_records` SETUP that writes N add events into the hero's vault log (internal/vault Store.Add on the throwaway hero) before the start, a drop driver (`debug give` a worthwhile item onto the floor in the area), and the assertions `vault_count`, `vault_records_present`, `vault_missed` and `vault_api` that read the log and the API. The same rules are covered offline by TestFullVaultNeverTrimsByDefault, TestVaultFullDoesNotTrimUnlessAutoTrim (Paladin and Sorceress), TestMarkedSalesWaitForConfirm and TestVaultFullPageShowsMissedAndMarked.
scenarios.provenance: Hero created fresh; the vault log is seeded by the new setup key `pre.vault_records` (not yet supported by the runner): CHEATED setup, mechanics evidence only.

assert.why: nothing left and nothing was added
every seeded record is still there
the worthwhile drop is counted as missed, not recorded

scenarios.notes: Vault seeded at capacity (400) with unpinned low-value records, loot.vaultAutoTrim 0 (default), a worthwhile unique drops. Expected: vault count unchanged, every seeded record present, no archive entry, nothing sold, the new drop not recorded and left on the ground, missed counter 1, no Ether gained. RED on the old code is the trim of the lowest record.
